title: Replay separation and receiver idempotence are different controls
summary: Session crypto rejects a secure frame replayed into a fresh nonce/transcript-bound connection, while legitimate fresh-session retransmission remains safe because durable Queue Fabric transfer receipts make receiver insertion idempotent by transferId.
invariants: Cryptographic replay separation is session-local and does not replace durable transferId idempotence.
A fresh legitimate retransmission may authenticate successfully and must still be deduplicated by the receiver receipt.
Do not treat an IP address, nonce or HMAC tag as the application delivery identity.

provenance.claim: Cross-session secure-frame replay fails while durable transferId receipts remain the receiver-side idempotence authority.
Failure expectations distinguish fresh-session replay rejection from legitimate fresh-session transferId idempotence.
Qualification includes cross-session replay rejection and legitimate fresh-connection receiver idempotence.
